description: Post a message to a WhatsApp Channel newsletter. All subscribers receive the message. Provide at least one of text or mediaUrl. This triggers delivery and cannot be undone.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the newsletter to post to

mediaUrl.description: URL of the media file to attach (required for image, video, or document types)

text.description: Message text or caption to post to the newsletter

name: neuron_post_to_newsletter
title: Post to Newsletter
